You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Include the MODULE declaration, EXTENDS, CONSTANTS, VARIABLES, Init, Next and Spec. Include all safety invariants and liveness properties described, and any fairness conditions mentioned. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This file contains two TLA+ modules. The first module, Github790, specifies a trivial one-variable system in which the variable a is initialized to 0 and every next-state step leaves a unchanged, so the behavior is entirely stuttering after initialization. It defines a temporal specification Spec as Init /\ [][Next]_a and also defines a temporal formula AlwaysTrue asserting <>TRUE => <>[]TRUE. The second module, Github790_proof, extends the first and TLAPS and proves the theorem AlwaysTrue using the PTL backend; there is no fault model and no PlusCal algorithm.
